entities.summary: The Kulmiye Peace, Unity and Development Party, also known as simply Kulmiye, is a political party in Somaliland. The party was founded by Ahmed Mohamed Mohamoud "Silanyo" in May 2002, ahead of the first municipal elections later that year. The party is mainly supported by people from the Habr Je'lo, Habr Awal and Darod clans. Peace, Unity, and Development Party is a political party in Hargeisa, established in 2002-05-01. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
